stated: Reform UK will launch a Joint Acquisition Corp to ensure world-class defence procurement, listening to soldiers on the front line to ensure they receive the equipment needed.

source.quote: Reform Defence Procurement Launch a Joint Acquisition Corp to ensure world class procurement. The Ministry of Defence must listen to soldiers on the front line and ensure they get the equipment they need.

bearing_set.reason: Reforming defence procurement directly affects the military's capacity to equip and field effective forces, bearing materially on national security and defence posture.

membership_note: This is a single-target policy focused on military capability. There is no specified budget figure or funding mechanism, so no pinnable O12 (public finances) effect — procurement reform could yield efficiency savings or higher spend; the direction is unspecified. Spillovers to O13 (defence-industry jobs/productivity) are plausible but too indirect and unspecified to clear the non-negligible bar.
